---
title: "States"
---

Explore state-by-state support across presidential administrations from Harry Truman to Donald Trump. Because nationwide polling historically did not track 50-state approval ratings continuously, state-level presidential election returns serve as the standard historical measure of geographical public support.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)

# Load state support dataset
state_data <- read_csv("data/presidential_state_support.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

pres_order <- c(
  "Harry Truman", "Dwight Eisenhower", "John F. Kennedy", "Lyndon Johnson",
  "Richard Nixon", "Gerald Ford", "Jimmy Carter", "Ronald Reagan",
  "George H.W. Bush", "Bill Clinton", "George W. Bush", "Barack Obama",
  "Donald Trump", "Joe Biden", "Donald Trump (Second Term)"
)

state_data <- state_data |>
  mutate(president = factor(president, levels = pres_order))

presidents <- levels(state_data$president)

pres_terms <- c(
  "Harry Truman" = "1945–1953",
  "Dwight Eisenhower" = "1953–1961",
  "John F. Kennedy" = "1961–1963",
  "Lyndon Johnson" = "1963–1969",
  "Richard Nixon" = "1969–1974",
  "Gerald Ford" = "1974–1977",
  "Jimmy Carter" = "1977–1981",
  "Ronald Reagan" = "1981–1989",
  "George H.W. Bush" = "1989–1993",
  "Bill Clinton" = "1993–2001",
  "George W. Bush" = "2001–2009",
  "Barack Obama" = "2009–2017",
  "Donald Trump" = "2017–2021",
  "Joe Biden" = "2021–2025",
  "Donald Trump (Second Term)" = "2025–present"
)

pres_images <- c(
  "Harry Truman" = "images/presidents/truman.jpg",
  "Dwight Eisenhower" = "images/presidents/eisenhower.jpg",
  "John F. Kennedy" = "images/presidents/kennedy.jpg",
  "Lyndon Johnson" = "images/presidents/johnson.jpg",
  "Richard Nixon" = "images/presidents/nixon.jpg",
  "Gerald Ford" = "images/presidents/ford.jpg",
  "Jimmy Carter" = "images/presidents/carter.jpg",
  "Ronald Reagan" = "images/presidents/reagan.jpg",
  "George H.W. Bush" = "images/presidents/bush41.jpg",
  "Bill Clinton" = "images/presidents/clinton.jpg",
  "George W. Bush" = "images/presidents/bush43.jpg",
  "Barack Obama" = "images/presidents/obama.jpg",
  "Donald Trump" = "images/presidents/trump.jpg",
  "Joe Biden" = "images/presidents/biden.jpg",
  "Donald Trump (Second Term)" = "images/presidents/trump.jpg"
)

make_state_map <- function(pres) {
  sub <- state_data |> filter(president == pres)
  p_party <- sub$party[1]
  yr <- sub$election_year[1]
  
  cscale <- if (identical(p_party, "Republican")) {
    list(
      c(0, "#fee2e2"),
      c(0.25, "#fca5a5"),
      c(0.5, "#ef4444"),
      c(0.75, "#b91c1c"),
      c(1, "#7f1d1d")
    )
  } else {
    list(
      c(0, "#e0f2fe"),
      c(0.25, "#7dd3fc"),
      c(0.5, "#3b82f6"),
      c(0.75, "#1d4ed8"),
      c(1, "#172554")
    )
  }
  
  hover_txt <- paste0(
    "<b>", sub$state, "</b><br>",
    "Support: <b>", sub$vote_pct, "%</b><br>",
    "Election: ", yr
  )
  
  p <- plot_ly(
    type = "choropleth",
    locations = sub$state_po,
    locationmode = "USA-states",
    z = sub$vote_pct,
    text = hover_txt,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    colorscale = cscale,
    zmin = 25,
    zmax = 75,
    colorbar = list(
      title = list(text = "Support (%)", font = list(color = "#94a3b8", size = 12)),
      tickfont = list(color = "#94a3b8"),
      ticksuffix = "%",
      len = 0.8
    ),
    marker = list(line = list(color = "#0f172a", width = 1.2))
  ) |>
  layout(
    geo = list(
      scope = "usa",
      projection = list(type = "albers usa"),
      showlakes = TRUE,
      lakecolor = "rgba(11, 15, 22, 0.95)",
      bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    ),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 10, b = 10)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  
  p$preRenderHook <- NULL
  p
}

maps <- lapply(presidents, make_state_map)

tagList(
  tags$div(
    style = "max-width: 420px; margin-bottom: 25px;",
    tags$label(`for` = "presSelect", style = "font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; display: block; color: #f8fafc; font-size: 1rem;", "Select Administration:"),
    tags$select(
      id = "presSelect",
      class = "form-select",
      style = "background-color: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 8px;",
      onchange = "switchPresident(this.value)",
      lapply(seq_along(presidents), \(i) {
        p_name <- presidents[i]
        tags$option(value = paste0("pres-state-", i), paste0(p_name, " (", pres_terms[p_name], ")"))
      })
    )
  ),
  lapply(seq_along(presidents), \(i) {
    p_name <- presidents[i]
    p_term <- pres_terms[p_name]
    p_img <- pres_images[p_name]
    sub <- state_data |> filter(president == p_name)
    p_party <- sub$party[1]
    p_yr <- sub$election_year[1]
    badge_bg <- if (identical(p_party, "Republican")) "#D9381E" else "#2E74C0"
    
    # State extremes
    valid_sub <- sub |> filter(!is.na(vote_pct), vote_pct > 0)
    best_st <- valid_sub |> slice_max(vote_pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    worst_st <- valid_sub |> slice_min(vote_pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    avg_support <- round(mean(valid_sub$vote_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

    tags$div(
      id = paste0("pres-state-", i),
      class = "pres-state-container",
      style = if (i == 1) "display: block;" else "display: none;",
      tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          "display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; ",
          "margin: 10px 0 25px 0; padding: 18px 24px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); ",
          "border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-left: 6px solid ", badge_bg, "; ",
          "border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);"
        ),
        tags$div(
          style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px;",
          tags$img(
            src = p_img,
            alt = paste(p_name, "portrait"),
            style = "width: 75px; height: 95px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);"
          ),
          tags$div(
            tags$h3(style = "margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff;", paste0(p_name, " (", p_term, ")")),
            tags$div(
              style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;",
              tags$span(
                style = paste0("display: inline-block; padding: 3px 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background-color: ", badge_bg, "; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);"),
                p_party
              ),
              tags$span(
                style = "color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500;",
                paste0("Election Year: ", p_yr)
              )
            )
          )
        ),
        tags$div(
          style = "display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap;",
          tags$div(
            style = "text-align: right; min-width: 110px;",
            tags$div(style = "font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #94a3b8;", "Avg Support"),
            tags$div(style = "font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f8fafc;", paste0(avg_support, "%"))
          ),
          tags$div(
            style = "text-align: right; min-width: 130px;",
            tags$div(style = "font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #94a3b8;", "Highest State"),
            tags$div(style = "font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: #38bdf8;", paste0(best_st$state, " (", best_st$vote_pct, "%)"))
          ),
          tags$div(
            style = "text-align: right; min-width: 130px;",
            tags$div(style = "font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #94a3b8;", "Lowest State"),
            tags$div(style = "font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: #f87171;", paste0(worst_st$state, " (", worst_st$vote_pct, "%)"))
          )
        )
      ),
      maps[[i]]
    )
  }),
  tags$script(HTML("
    function switchPresident(val) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pres-state-container').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
      const target = document.getElementById(val);
      if (target) {
        target.style.display = 'block';
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
      }
    }
  "))
)
```
